corrected_cohort.reproducer_program:
import json,collections
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from experiments.openexempt_online import actor_payload,csha,metrics
root=Path.cwd();p=root/'runs/legal_openexempt_adaptive_legal_public_assets128_20261026_run01'
cfg=json.loads((root/'configs/openexempt_adaptive_legal_public_assets128_20261026_run01.json').read_text())
previous=json.loads((p/'publications/b6.json').read_text())['bank'];current=json.loads((p/'publications/b7.json').read_text())['bank']
old={s['id']:s for s in previous};new={s['id']:s for s in current}
added=set(new)-set(old);assert len(added)==1 and all(new[s]==old[s] for s in old)
sid=next(iter(added));assert new[sid]['hypothesis_ids']==['EC'] and new[sid]['guidance']['jurisdiction']=='WISCONSIN'
rows={(r['case_id'],r['family']):r for r in json.loads((root/cfg['input_packet']).read_text())['rows'] if r['batch']==8}
r=json.loads((p/'batches/b8_prequential_records.json').read_text())
assert len(r['skills'])==32
print(json.dumps({'roles':list(r),'new_skill_id':sid,'new_skill':new[sid],'metadata':{'B7_only_added_one_EC_WI':True,'B8_complete':(p/'batches/b8_prequential.json').is_file()}}))
by={role:{(x['case_id'],x['family']):x for x in records} for role,records in r.items() if isinstance(records,list)}
b1role='frozen_after_B1'
assert all(r['bank_sha256']=='509fcf9408a5c92719df6a799693487db3bd8ff00fb3178e79a88b9665b87860' for r in by[b1role].values())
out=[];delivery_counts=collections.Counter()
for key,row in sorted(rows.items()):
 messages,schema,_=actor_payload(row,current,grounded=True,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
 supplied=json.loads(messages[1]['content'].split('\n',1)[1]) if len(messages)>2 else []
 raw=json.loads((root/by['skills'][key]['raw_call_path']).read_text())
 assert raw['calls'][0]['request']['messages']==messages and raw['calls'][0]['request']['response_format']['json_schema']['schema']==schema
 delivery_counts['all_original_native_requests_verified']+=1
 present=sid in [s['id'] for s in supplied]
 if key[1]=='EV':
  assert not present;delivery_counts['EV_new_EC_card_absent']+=1;continue
 if not present:
  delivery_counts['EC_outside_public_scope_card_absent']+=1;continue
 delivery_counts['EC_public_scope_card_present']+=1
 a,b,e=(by[role][key] for role in ['skills',b1role,'empty'])
 oldmsgs,_,_=actor_payload(row,json.loads((p/'frozen_after_B1.json').read_text())['bank'],grounded=True,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
 removed=[{**m,'content':m['content']} for m in messages]
 prompt_without=[s for s in supplied if s['id']!=sid]
 removed[1]['content']=messages[1]['content'].split('\n',1)[0]+'\n'+json.dumps(prompt_without,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
 out.append({'case_id':key[0],'family':'EC','public_namespace':row['components']['solved_steps'],'all_delivered_skill_ids':[s['id'] for s in supplied],'main_native_F1':a['score']['f1'],'own_B1_native_F1':b['score']['f1'],'empty_native_F1':e['score']['f1'],'delta_ownB1_pp':100*(a['score']['f1']-b['score']['f1']),'main_full_output_F1':a['score']['full_output_f1'],'ownB1_full_output_F1':b['score']['full_output_f1'],'main_parse_error':a['parse_error'],'main_original_request':a['raw_call_path'],'ownB1_original_request':b['raw_call_path'],'removing_new_WI_card_recreates_ownB1_wire':removed==oldmsgs})
assert len(out)==5,len(out)
assert dict(delivery_counts)=={'all_original_native_requests_verified':32,'EC_public_scope_card_present':5,'EV_new_EC_card_absent':16,'EC_outside_public_scope_card_absent':11},dict(delivery_counts)
summary={'at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'classification':'All public-applicable B8 EC views after B7 sole Wisconsin EC creation; complete closed firstforecasts only, not a single-card intervention or TEST','skill_id':sid,'actual_bank_sha256':csha(current),'new_skill_tasks':['EC'],'EC_supplied_to_five_B8_public_eligible_views_verified':out,'EC_not_supplied_to_remaining11_B8_views_or_any16_EV_views':True,'actual_native_delivery_counts':dict(delivery_counts),'mean_main_native_F1_percent':100*sum(x['main_native_F1'] for x in out)/5,'mean_ownB1_native_F1_percent':100*sum(x['own_B1_native_F1'] for x in out)/5,'mean_empty_native_F1_percent':100*sum(x['empty_native_F1'] for x in out)/5,'main_versus_ownB1_help_hurt_tie':[sum(x['delta_ownB1_pp']>1e-10 for x in out),sum(x['delta_ownB1_pp']< -1e-10 for x in out),sum(abs(x['delta_ownB1_pp'])<=1e-10 for x in out)],'not_a_one_skill_causal_comparison_due_to_other_B1_to_B7_edits':not all(x['removing_new_WI_card_recreates_ownB1_wire'] for x in out),'no_extra_model_teacher_grader_or_solver_call':True}
print(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False))
